clue.text: Requirement involving accountant's capital in Arabia

indicators.note: involving means one word wraps round and takes in the other

parts.note: a must is something required
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: Some necessity concerning an accountant's money held in the Arab world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks like money for the accountant, but it is a city: MUSCAT is the capital of Oman.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscat is the seat of government of Oman, on the Arabian peninsula.

clue.text: Handle male writer's complete works

parts.note: a man is a male
an oeuvre is the whole body of an artist's work

explanation.surface: Tackle a male author's collected writings.
explanation.definitionFit: To manoeuvre something is to steer or guide it skilfully.

clue.text: Makes an effort to produce music

definitions.meaning: melodies or tunes, often as in the ... of a song

explanation.surface: Struggling to make music.
explanation.definitionFit: To strain is to exert oneself hard, and strains are passages of melody.

clue.text: Such a person's engaged in gathering information

definitions.text: Such a person's engaged in gathering information

parts.words: Such a person's engaged in gathering information
parts.note: a person employed to spy and collect intelligence

explanation.surface: Someone employed to collect information.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret agent is a spy working to obtain intelligence.

clue.text: A hormone, 'possibly, used to build a heavenly body

parts.note: a steroid is one kind of hormone, hence 'possibly'

explanation.surface: A hormone could be used in building a fine physique, a heavenly body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heavenly body' suggests a beautiful physique to go with the hormone; it is a rock orbiting the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: An asteroid is a small rocky object orbiting the sun, a celestial body.

clue.text: Emotional type moved soldiers in it over a border

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first part sits above the next

parts.note: sent means moved, dispatched

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: the word it, as written
men are soldiers, the ranks
a list is a border or selvage of cloth

explanation.surface: A sentimental sort sent soldiers in across a frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'over' do the placing; a list is an old word for a strip or selvage of cloth, hence a border.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentimentalist is someone ruled by tender feelings rather than reason.

clue.text: Directions to comparatively dense copyist

parts.note: E and N are compass directions, east and north
gross means dense or thick, so grosser is more so

explanation.surface: Instructions given to a rather slow-witted copy clerk.
explanation.walkthrough: An engrosser writes out legal documents in a large fair hand.
explanation.definitionFit: An engrosser is a clerk who copies out formal legal deeds in final form.

clue.text: Favourable opportunity for counsel's preliminary statement

definitions.meaning: the barrister's ... speech at the start of a trial

explanation.surface: A good chance for a lawyer to begin his case.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening is a chance, and in court counsel opens the case with an introductory speech.

clue.text: Live and prosper, none the less

indicators.note: less means taken away, so the nought goes

parts.note: to do well is to prosper
O, a nought, stands for none

explanation.surface: Live long and prosper, all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface echoes the Star Trek blessing. 'none the less' reads as nevertheless; it is O (nothing) taken from DO WELL.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell is to reside or inhabit a place.

clue.text: Be tolerant over vice and be permissive, as it happens

indicators.note: in a down clue over means turned upside down, read the other way

parts.note: evil is wickedness, vice
to let is to permit
a live broadcast goes out as events happen

explanation.surface: Show tolerance over vice and allow things, whatever happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns EVIL to LIVE. 'as it happens' looks like a filler phrase; it means live.
explanation.definitionFit: To accept others' ways without interfering is the meaning of the proverbial phrase, tolerance.

clue.text: European wearing no shifts

indicators.note: shifts means the letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A European goes about wearing no shifts, or slips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifts' looks like a garment the European is not wearing, but it is the anagram signal on WEARING NO.
explanation.definitionFit: A Norwegian comes from Norway, a country in Europe.

clue.text: Flighty type in-work unit rejected by 12

indicators.note: rejected means the word is sent back, read in reverse

parts.note: the erg is a unit of work in physics
the answer to 12 across means to be, so it supplies BE

explanation.surface: A fickle sort in a work team gets turned down by number 12.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' signals the reversal; 12 across is EXIST, so its synonym is used. 'Flighty' looks like fickle but means able to fly.
explanation.definitionFit: A grebe is a diving water bird, and as a bird it is a creature of flight.

clue.text: Obtain leave to accommodate son

indicators.note: to accommodate means to give room inside, so one word holds the other

parts.note: to exit is to leave

explanation.surface: Secure permission to leave so as to put up a son.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Obtain' reads as get, but here it is the intransitive sense, to be in force or prevail.
explanation.definitionFit: Customs that obtain are ones that are current or prevail, which is to be present or real.

clue.text: As leader, I led a trio in new composition

indicators.note: a new composition puts these letters together again in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A group leader explains he led a trio playing a newly written piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' suggests a bandleader with his trio; in newspapers a leader is the main opinion column.
explanation.definitionFit: A leader or leading article is the newspaper's opinion piece written by its staff.

clue.text: Noblewoman improperly sent into sticky situation

indicators.note: into means one set of letters is placed inside the other

parts.note: viscous means sticky, thick and slow-flowing; 'situation' rounds out the phrase

indicators.note: improperly means the letters are wrongly arranged

explanation.surface: A lady of rank has been wrongly packed off into a tight spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'improperly' scrambles the word sent and 'into' places it in the sticky word. 'situation' is a slightly loose addition to the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A viscountess is a woman holding the rank of viscount, a peer just below an earl.

clue.text: Put down page printer needed to go in dictionary

indicators.note: to go in means these pieces are placed inside the other word

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a press is a printing machine

explanation.surface: Set down a page the printing works needs to include in a dictionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put down' suggests writing something down; it means crushed or kept down.
explanation.definitionFit: Oppressed people are subjugated, kept under by tyranny.

clue.text: Creature even characters of ge-. nius disregarded

indicators.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters of the word genius are the even ones
disregarded means those even letters are dropped, so the alternate odd ones remain

explanation.surface: A creature with no use for even the characteristics of genius.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the even letters E, I, S leaves the first, third and fifth.
explanation.definitionFit: The gnu, or wildebeest, is an African antelope, an animal.

clue.text: She may be brightly beaming as she shows us the way

definitions.text: She may be brightly beaming as she shows us the way

parts.words: She may be brightly beaming as she shows us the way
parts.note: a cinema attendant whose torch beam lights the way to our seats, rather than a cheerful smile

explanation.surface: A happy guide smiles as she leads us.
explanation.definitionFit: A cinema or theatre attendant who shows people to their seats with a torch.

clue.text: The first lady the day before the feast

definitions.meaning: in Genesis she is the first woman, mate of Adam
the evening or day before a holiday, as on Christmas

explanation.surface: Eden's first woman, or the eve of a festival.
explanation.definitionFit: Eve was the first woman in the Bible, and an eve is the day before a festival.

clue.text: Graceful member in unusually neat clothing

indicators.note: clothing means the outer letters wrap around the inner piece
unusually means the letters are put in a strange order

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A shapely limb in unusually tidy clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' rearranges NEAT to EANT, which clothes LEG.
explanation.definitionFit: Elegant means stylish and refined, full of grace.

clue.text: Recover device for cleaning barrel

definitions.meaning: to recover from illness is to survive it, get better
a cord with a weight and rag drawn along a gun barrel to clean it

explanation.surface: Getting better, and a gadget to clean out a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull through is to survive an illness; a pull-through is a cord with a rag for cleaning a rifle bore.

clue.text: A large number meet up somehow before noon

indicators.note: before in a down clue says one part comes ahead of the next
somehow says the letters are arranged in some way

explanation.surface: Many meet up in some fashion before midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges MEET UP to UMPTEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Umpteen is informal for very many, an indefinitely large count.

clue.text: Concerned with water, perhaps, or a spirit

definitions.meaning: relating to the four classical elements, of which water is one
a nature spirit of earth, air, fire or water, as in folklore

explanation.surface: Something to do with water, perhaps, or a ghostly being.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemental describes the elements such as water, and an elemental is a supernatural being of those elements.

clue.text: English bishop found in disreputable joint

indicators.note: found in means one is placed inside the other

parts.note: low means base, disreputable
B abbreviates bishop, as in chess notation

explanation.surface: An English clergyman discovered in a sleazy bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joint' looks like a dive to go with 'disreputable'; it is a body joint.
explanation.definitionFit: The elbow is the hinge between upper arm and forearm.

clue.text: Some exhort a person to come to the point

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Urge someone to get to the point of the matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to come to the point' reads as getting to the heart of an argument; here it is narrowing to a tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that tapers narrows gradually until it ends in a fine tip.

clue.text: Roughly, supporting end of elephant's trunk

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting means sitting underneath, as a base
the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: or so means roughly, approximately

explanation.surface: Roughly holding up an elephant's trunk at its tip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trunk' tempts as the elephant's nose; it is the body. OR SO sits under T in the down grid.
explanation.definitionFit: The trunk of the body is the main part without the head and limbs.

clue.text: The -effrontery of some musicians!

definitions.meaning: the section of an orchestra playing horns, trumpets and trombones

explanation.surface: An exclamation at the cheek of certain players.
explanation.definitionFit: Brass means impudent nerve, and the brass are the trumpet and horn players of an orchestra.

clue.text: Cover books about key rebel

indicators.note: about means the first letters go around the next piece

parts.note: to insure something is to give it cover
G is a musical key
NT is the New Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: A rebel's books get insurance concerning a key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' places the key inside the cover-plus-books string; NT for New Testament is a standard crossword abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurgent is someone rising in revolt against authority.

clue.text: Retired humorist takes husband picked at random

parts.note: a wit is a humorist
to draw lots is to pick at random

explanation.surface: A comedian who has quit picks a husband by lottery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' suggests a pensioner comic; here it means went away, the past of withdraw.
explanation.definitionFit: To withdraw is to retreat or retire from a place.

clue.text: No student is without personal support on course

indicators.note: is without means the outer word stands outside the other

parts.note: a golf tee supports the ball on the course
own means personal, belonging to oneself

explanation.surface: A non-student lacks personal backing on his course of study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' suggests a university course; it is a golf course. A townee is a resident in a university town, as opposed to a gown.
explanation.definitionFit: Town versus gown sets local residents against university members, so a townee is a non-academic local.
